svg.title: Side effects at day 14 (% of patients)
svg.desc: Day 14 adverse events, selank vs phenazepam: sedation 0 vs 100%, attention problems 7 vs 97%, longer sleep 13 vs 93%, memory problems 10 vs 83%, asthenia 3 vs 77%, sexual dysfunction 0 vs 73%.
